intro.title: useToggle
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a custom Vue composable called `useToggle` that manages a boolean state and provides a function to toggle it. You will learn the core concept of state management using Vue's `ref` and `computed` APIs to create reactive values. The main technologies involved are Vue 3's Composition API and JavaScript functions for reusable logic. By the end, you'll understand how to encapsulate and reuse stateful logic in your Vue applications.
intro.usecase: The useToggle pattern is essential for managing binary state across interactive UI components in real applications. Developers use it to control visibility of modals, expand/collapse panels in dashboards, toggle between light/dark themes, and switch filters on data tables. In e-commerce sites, it powers product comparison toggles; in admin panels, it manages sidebar menus and detail view expansions. This reusable hook eliminates repetitive state logic, making code cleaner and more maintainable across complex interfaces.
